strings.activitychooseractivefooter_desc: The activity chooser can support plugins that add items to the footer.
strings.browsecourseadminindex: Browse the course administration with this index.
strings.completion_manual:aria:done: {$a} is marked as done. Press to undo.
strings.completion_setby:manual:done: {$a->activityname} is marked by {$a->setby} as done. Press to undo.
strings.completion_setby:manual:markdone: {$a->activityname} is marked by {$a->setby} as not done. Press to mark as done.
strings.coursecommunication_desc: The default communication service for new courses. Existing courses will not have any provider selected by default.
strings.coursecontentnotification_help: Tick the box to notify course participants about this new or changed activity or resource. Only users who can access the activity or resource will receive the notification.
strings.coursecontentnotifnewbody:
{$a->moduletypename} {$a->modulename} is new in the course {$a->coursename}.

Change your notification preferences
strings.coursecontentnotifupdatebody:
{$a->moduletypename} {$a->modulename} has been changed in the course {$a->coursename}.

Change your notification preferences
strings.coursenotyetfinished: The course has not yet finished
strings.coursenotyetstarted: The course has not yet started
strings.customfield_islocked_help: If the field is locked, only users with the capability to change locked custom fields (by default users with the default role of manager only) will be able to change it in the course settings.
strings.customfield_visibility_help: This setting determines who can view the custom field name and value in the list of courses or in the available custom field filter of the Dashboard.
strings.downloadcontent_help:
Should this activity or resource be included in the zip file of course content available for download? File, Folder, Page and Label can be fully downloaded. For all other activities and resources, only the name and description are downloaded. This option requires download course content to be enabled in the course settings.

The setting has no effect on mobile app content download for offline usage.
strings.downloadcourseconfirmation: You are about to download a zip file of course content (excluding items which cannot be downloaded and any files larger than {$a}).
strings.downloadcoursecontent_help: This setting determines whether course content may be downloaded by users with the download course content capability (by default users with the role of student or teacher).
strings.errorendbeforestart: The end date ({$a}) is before the course start date.
strings.gradetopassnotset: This course does not have a grade to pass set. It may be set in the grade item of the course (Gradebook setup).
strings.noaccesssincestartinfomessage:

strings.nocourseactivity: Not enough course activity between the start and the end of the course
strings.nocourseendtime: The course does not have an end time
strings.norecentaccessesinfomessage:
Hi {$a->userfirstname},

A number of students in {$a->coursename} have not accessed the course recently.
strings.noteachinginfomessage:
Hi {$a->userfirstname},

Courses with start dates in the next week have been identified as having no teacher or student enrolments.
strings.overview_info: An overview of all activities in the course, with dates and other information.
strings.participants:perpage_help: The number of users shown per page on the participants page in each course.
strings.pdfexportfont_help: The font to be used for generated PDF files, such as assignment submissions.
strings.privacy:metadata:activityfavouritessumma: The course system contains information about which items from the activity chooser have been starred by the user.
strings.privacy:metadata:completionsummary: The course contains completion information about the user.
strings.privacy:metadata:favouritessummary: The course contains information relating to the course being starred by the user.
strings.privacy:perpage: The number of courses to show per page.
strings.studentsatriskinfomessage:
Hi {$a->userfirstname},

Students in the {$a->coursename} course have been identified as being at risk.
strings.target:coursecompetencies: Students at risk of not achieving the competencies assigned to a course
strings.target:coursecompetencies_help: This target describes whether a student is at risk of not achieving the competencies assigned to a course. This target considers that all competencies assigned to the course must be achieved by the end of the course.
strings.target:coursecompletion: Students at risk of not meeting the course completion conditions
strings.target:coursecompletion_help: This target describes whether the student is considered at risk of not meeting the course completion conditions.
strings.target:coursedropout: Students at risk of dropping out
strings.target:coursedropout_help: This target describes whether the student is considered at risk of dropping out.
strings.target:coursegradetopass: Students at risk of not achieving the minimum grade to pass the course
strings.target:coursegradetopass_help: This target describes whether the student is at risk of not achieving the minimum grade to pass the course.
strings.target:noaccesssincecoursestart: Students who have not accessed the course yet
strings.target:noaccesssincecoursestart_help: This target describes students who never accessed a course they are enrolled in.
strings.target:noaccesssincecoursestartinfo: The following students are enrolled in a course which has started, but they have never accessed the course.
strings.target:norecentaccesses: Students who have not accessed the course recently
strings.target:norecentaccesses_help: This target identifies students who have not accessed a course they are enrolled in within the set analysis interval (by default the past month).
strings.target:norecentaccessesinfo: The following students have not accessed a course they are enrolled in within the set analysis interval (by default the past month).
strings.target:noteachingactivity: Courses at risk of not starting
strings.target:noteachingactivity_help: This target describes whether courses due to start in the coming week will have teaching activity.
strings.target:noteachingactivityinfo: The following courses due to start in the upcoming days are at risk of not starting because they don't have teachers or students enrolled.

strings.targetlabelstudentcompletionyes: Student at risk of not meeting the course completion conditions
